taxBrackets.label: Federal tax brackets
taxBrackets.source: T1 Step 5 Part A. The lowest rate went from 15% to 14% on July 1, 2025, so 14.5% applies for the year. Bases as printed on the form.

creditRate.label: Federal credit rate
creditRate.source: T1 line 114: federal non-refundable tax credit rate for 2025

basicPersonalAmountMax.label: Basic personal amount, full
basicPersonalAmountMax.source: T1 line 30000 and Federal Worksheet: $16,129 when net income is $177,882 or less

basicPersonalAmountMin.label: Basic personal amount, minimum
basicPersonalAmountMin.source: T1 line 30000 and Federal Worksheet: $14,538 when net income is $253,414 or more

basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart.label: Net income where the basic personal amount starts to go down

basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd.label: Net income where the basic personal amount reaches its minimum
basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd.source: Federal Worksheet, line 30000: threshold plus the 75,532 range

ageAmountMax.label: Age amount, full
ageAmountMax.source: T1 line 30100 and Federal Worksheet: maximum $9,028 for people born in 1960 or earlier

ageAmountThreshold.label: Net income where the age amount starts to go down

canadaEmploymentAmount.label: Canada employment amount
canadaEmploymentAmount.source: T1 line 31260: whichever is less, $1,471 or employment income

cppBaseRate.label: CPP base rate
cppBaseRate.source: Schedule 8: the base part of the 5.95% employee rate (4.95%) is a credit on line 30800

cppEmployeeMax.label: Most CPP contributions for an employee
cppEmployeeMax.source: CRA payroll table, 2025: maximum employee contribution $4,034.10

cpp2EmployeeMax.label: Most second CPP contributions for an employee
cpp2EmployeeMax.source: CRA payroll table, 2025: CPP2 maximum employee contribution $396

enhancedCppDeductionMax.label: Most deduction for enhanced CPP contributions

medicalThresholdMax.label: Medical expense threshold, most
medicalThresholdMax.source: T1 line 109: whichever is less, $2,834 or 3% of net income

donationLowRate.label: Donation credit rate on the first $200

donationTopRate.label: Donation credit rate on income in the top bracket
donationTopRate.source: Schedule 9 line 20: 33% on the part of donations up to taxable income over $253,414

donationTopThreshold.label: Taxable income where the top donation rate starts

donationIncomeLimit.label: Donation limit, share of net income

topUpThreshold.label: Credits that the 14.5% rate fully covers

tuitionIncomeThreshold.label: Taxable income up to which tuition is limited by taxable income

onTaxBrackets.label: Ontario tax brackets
onTaxBrackets.source: ON428 Part A, bases as printed on the form

onCreditRate.label: Ontario credit rate
onCreditRate.source: ON428 line 45: Ontario non-refundable tax credit rate

onAgeAmountThreshold.label: Net income where the Ontario age amount starts to go down

onMedicalThresholdMax.label: Ontario medical expense threshold, most
onMedicalThresholdMax.source: ON428 line 40: whichever is less, $2,885 or 3% of net income

onDonationLowRate.label: Ontario donation credit rate on the first $200

onDividendEligibleRate.label: Ontario dividend tax credit rate, eligible dividends
onDividendEligibleRate.source: Worksheet ON428, line 61520: 10% of the taxable amount of eligible dividends

onDividendOtherRate.label: Ontario dividend tax credit rate, other dividends
onDividendOtherRate.source: Worksheet ON428, line 61520: 2.9863% of the taxable amount of other than eligible dividends

onSurtaxThreshold1.label: Ontario surtax, first threshold
onSurtaxThreshold1.source: ON428 line 66: 20% of Ontario tax over $5,710

onSurtaxThreshold2.label: Ontario surtax, second threshold
onSurtaxThreshold2.source: ON428 line 67: 36% of Ontario tax over $7,307

liftRate.label: LIFT credit, share of employment income

T1.12000.label: Taxable amount of dividends (eligible and other than eligible)
T1.12000.source: Federal Worksheet, line 12000: boxes 11 and 25 of T5 slips, boxes 32 and 50 of T3 slips

T1.12010.label: Taxable amount of dividends other than eligible

T1.12100.label: Interest and other investment income
T1.12100.source: Federal Worksheet, line 12100: box 13 of T5 slips, box 25 of T3 slips

T1.12700.label: Taxable capital gains
T1.12700.source: Schedule 3. A net capital loss isn't entered here; it carries forward

T1.21200.label: Annual union, professional, or like dues

T1.22215.label: Deduction for CPP enhanced contributions on employment income
T1.22215.source: Schedule 8 for employees: the first enhancement (1% of 5.95%) and all second CPP contributions are deducted

T1.30000.label: Basic personal amount
T1.30000.formula:
round(param.basicPersonalAmountMax
  - (param.basicPersonalAmountMax - param.basicPersonalAmountMin)
  * clamp(line.T1.23600 - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart, 0, param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart)
  / (param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart), 2)
T1.30000.source: Federal Worksheet, line 30000: the full amount up to the 26% bracket, going down to the minimum at the 33% bracket

T1.30100.label: Age amount
T1.30100.formula: if(person.age >= 65, max(0, param.ageAmountMax - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.ageAmountThreshold) * param.ageAmountRate, 2)), 0)
T1.30100.source: Federal Worksheet, line 30100: for people born in 1960 or earlier

T1.30800.label: Base CPP contributions through employment
T1.30800.source: Schedule 8 for employees: the base part (4.95% of 5.95%) is a credit

T1.33200.label: Allowable medical expenses
T1.33200.source: T1 lines 107 to 112: expenses over whichever is less, $2,834 or 3% of net income

T1.33800.label: Credit amounts at the credit rate

T1.34990.label: Top-up tax credit
T1.34990.source: Federal Worksheet, line 34990: keeps credit amounts above the first bracket at 15%

T1.40425.label: Federal dividend tax credit
T1.40425.source: Federal Worksheet, line 40425: the credit as shown on the slips

T1.42800.label: Provincial tax
T1.42800.formula: if(person.province == "ON", line.ON428.90, unsupported("Provincial tax for British Columbia and Alberta comes in the next version of this app"))

T1.44800.label: CPP overpayment
T1.44800.formula: if(sum(T4.box16) > param.cppEmployeeMax or sum(T4.box16A) > param.cpp2EmployeeMax, unsupported("More CPP was deducted than the 2025 maximum. The overpayment (Schedule 8) isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

T1.45000.label: Employment insurance overpayment
T1.45000.formula: if(sum(T4.box18) > param.eiPremiumMax, unsupported("More EI was deducted than the 2025 maximum. The overpayment isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

S3.13200.label: Gain or loss on publicly traded shares and mutual fund units
S3.13200.source: Schedule 3 line 4: proceeds (T5008 box 20) minus cost (box 21)

S3.19900.label: Taxable capital gains or net capital loss

S9.5.label: Total eligible amount of charitable donations
S9.5.source: Schedule 9 line 5: official receipts, and box 46 of T4 slips

S9.10.label: Donations claimed (within the limit)
S9.10.source: Schedule 9 lines 6 to 10: up to 75% of net income

S9.19.label: Taxable income in the top bracket

S11.8.label: Tuition fees for 2025
S11.8.source: Schedule 11 lines 1 to 8: eligible fees from T2202 box 26. The Canada training credit isn't claimed

S11.9.label: Unused federal tuition from your 2024 notice of assessment

S11.11.label: Income the tuition amount can reduce to zero tax
S11.11.source: Schedule 11 line 11: taxable income, or above $57,375, federal tax on taxable income ÷ 14.5%

ON428.10.label: Ontario age amount
ON428.10.formula: if(person.age >= 65, max(0, param.onAgeAmountMax - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.onAgeAmountThreshold) * param.onAgeAmountRate, 2)), 0)
ON428.10.source: Worksheet ON428, line 58080: for people born in 1960 or earlier

ON428.24.label: CPP and EI credit amounts
ON428.24.source: ON428 lines 19 to 24: the federal amounts from lines 30800 and 31200

ON428.41.label: Allowable medical expenses
ON428.41.source: ON428 lines 36 to 41: expenses over whichever is less, $2,885 or 3% of net income

ON428.46.label: Ontario credit amounts at the credit rate

ON428.49.label: Ontario donations credit
ON428.49.source: ON428 lines 47 to 49: Schedule 9 lines 13 and 14 at 5.05% and 11.16%

ON428.68.label: Ontario surtax
ON428.68.formula: round(max(0, line.ON428.53 - param.onSurtaxThreshold1) * param.onSurtaxRate1, 2) + round(max(0, line.ON428.53 - param.onSurtaxThreshold2) * param.onSurtaxRate2, 2)
ON428.68.source: ON428 lines 63 to 68, on Ontario tax after credits (line 62)

ON428.73.label: Ontario tax after surtax and the dividend credit

ON428.80.label: Ontario tax reduction
ON428.80.source: ON428 lines 74 to 80: twice the reductions, less Ontario tax. Dependent children come with dependants

ON428.85.label: Low-income individuals and families tax (LIFT) credit

ON428.86.label: Ontario tax after the LIFT credit

ON428.89.label: Ontario health premium
ON428.89.source: ON428 line 89 chart: $0 to $900 by taxable income, in steps at $20,000, $36,000, $48,000, $72,000 and $200,000

ON428A.5.label: LIFT credit before the income test

ON428A.13.label: Adjusted net income
ON428A.13.source: ON428-A lines 6 to 13: net income before it was floored at zero

medicalExpenses.ask: Medical expenses you paid for yourself

donations.ask: Donations on official receipts (not on a T4)

unusedTuition.ask: Unused federal tuition from your 2024 notice of assessment

T4.title: T4 Statement of Remuneration Paid
T4.about: Employment income an employer paid, and the tax, CPP, EI and dues it withheld

T5.title: T5 Statement of Investment Income
T5.about: Interest, dividends and capital gains dividends from a bank, broker or corporation

boxes.10: Actual amount of dividends other than eligible dividends
boxes.11: Taxable amount of dividends other than eligible dividends
boxes.12: Dividend tax credit for dividends other than eligible dividends
boxes.26: Dividend tax credit for eligible dividends

T3.title: T3 Statement of Trust Income Allocations and Designations
T3.about: Income a trust or mutual fund allocated to you, such as capital gains, dividends and other income

boxes.23: Actual amount of dividends other than eligible dividends
boxes.32: Taxable amount of dividends other than eligible dividends
boxes.39: Dividend tax credit for dividends other than eligible dividends
boxes.51: Dividend tax credit for eligible dividends

T5008.title: T5008 Statement of Securities Transactions
T5008.about: A sale of shares, bonds or fund units through a broker, with the proceeds and, when the broker knows it, the cost

boxes.20: Proceeds of disposition or settlement amount

T2202.title: T2202 Tuition and Enrolment Certificate
T2202.about: Eligible tuition fees a college or university received, and the months of study
